newsitem.title: USA: U.S. sorghum weekly export sales highlights--USDA.
newsitem.headline: U.S. sorghum weekly export sales highlights--USDA.

text.p: USDA sorghum export sales highlights in latest report week:
Sales of 23,200 MT equaled the prior week, but were 40 percent below the 4-week average. Mexico (22,400 MT) and Japan (800 MT) were the buyers.
Sales of 16,300 MT for delivery in 1997/98 were all for Japan.
Exports of 45,400 MT were 6 percent above the prior week, but 21 percent under the 4-week average. The destinations were Mexico (36,500 MT) and Japan (8,900 MT).
